environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on GKE Autopilot with Pod Security Standard 'restricted' profile enforced at namespace level. Container image built with distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/java17-debian11). Pod spec sets securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes are mounted. The container's entire filesystem including /var, /tmp, and /var/cache/app is immutable at runtime. CACHE_DIR environment variable is set to /var/cache/app but the path is non-writable due to the read-only root filesystem constraint enforced by the container runtime (containerd with AppArmor profile restricting write syscalls to all mount points).

config.volumes: none (no emptyDir, no PVC, no hostPath, no tmpfs)
config.apparmor_profile: runtime/default (blocks write to all fs paths)
config.network: ClusterIP service behind Istio ingress gateway
